content.text: The rename is finished. The one failure came from a wrong assumption in the acceptance test I wrote last round, not from the source code. That test expected `list` to hide completed items by default. The existing spec test in `src/commands.test.ts` shows the real behaviour: `list(todos)` returns `"[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"`, so completed items are shown by default and only hidden when `includeDone: false` is passed. A rename shouldn't change behaviour, so I'm fixing the test.
